message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp (optional) |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (optional)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg (grated) | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if not using no‑boil). Drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, herbs, salt, pepper, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mix**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Optional bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season.
5. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mix, sauce, and cheese. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with cheese on top.
6. **Bake**: Cover with foil (to prevent sticking, spray foil with cooking spray), bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake an additional 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
